metadata.name: investscape-map-approval-admin
metadata.description: Manual map member approval with current revision and audit reconciliation through an explicit existing-session host.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Connect only after the Dev host is configured; editing mode always stays disconnected.

properties.name: apiOrigin
properties.description: Reviewed exact HTTPS Dev API origin; no paths, credentials or fallback.

specifications: Fluid root; uses the existing approval UI with component-scoped styles and instance-unique control IDs.
Network/subscription setup runs only onMounted in runtime/preview, never setup or editing mode.
The host must be registered on wwLib.getFrontWindow() under Symbol.for('investscape.map.session-host.v1'); no plugin accessor is guessed.
Host exposes issuer, readSession() and subscribe(listener), which returns an unsubscribe function. Session values stay in the transient transport.
Content changes and unmount dispose transport, cancel requests, unsubscribe and clear administrative UI state.
Session changes clear current membership/audit and cancel old responses. The server verifies tokens and access-admin authority independently.
No token/member/audit variables, browser storage, Auth configuration or staff capability assignment.
No automatic approval POST retry; uncertain results require persisted membership/audit reload.
